sloka: भूमौ सुतनुम् आसीनाम् नियताम् इव तापसीम् ।निःश्वास बहुलाम् भीरुम् भुजग इन्द्र वधूम् इव ॥५-१५-३१॥
transliteration: bhūmau sutanum āsīnām niyatām iva tāpasīm ।niḥśvāsa bahulām bhīrum bhujaga indra vadhūm iva ॥5-15-31॥

translations.english: The timid lady was hissing (sighing) like the consort of the serpent king, who being caught in a widespread cobweb of grief was looking gloomy.
